title: Bifrost gateway config (local validation)
description: Local schema enforcing the contract between this repo's Bifrost config and the deployed gateway. Catches drift before deploy: missing providers, wrong env-var references, drifted mlx-local routing, missing timeouts. Does NOT replace the upstream getbifrost.ai schema; it asserts the additional invariants this repo cares about.

$schema.description: Upstream Bifrost schema URL; preserved for editor tooling.

mcp_tool_execution_timeout.description: Max seconds for an MCP tool call routed via Bifrost.

providers.description: Locked to the four providers this stack supports. ANTHROPIC is intentionally absent — Claude Code talks to Anthropic directly. To add a provider, update both this schema and the deploy.

models.description: Empty array means the key applies to every model under this provider.

value.description: Cloud providers MUST reference a Doppler-injected env var. The literal 'not-needed' is rejected here on purpose — accepting it would let a broken config silently strip the API key requirement.
vllm-mlx accepts any token but requires *some* string. 'not-needed' is the literal sentinel; anything else may indicate a copy-paste mistake.

base_url.description: MUST be host.docker.internal:11434 — Bifrost reaches the macOS-hosted vllm-mlx server through Docker's host alias. Any other URL means the local MLX path is broken.

default_request_timeout_in_seconds.description: Cold-load of large MLX models can exceed 60s. Below this threshold means we will routinely time out on first request after a model swap.

base_provider_type.description: vllm-mlx exposes an OpenAI-compatible API; mlx-local is wired as a custom provider on top of openai.
